comment: The table again with Wash at 6 and 36 px, a pen's rate of four motions a frame beside it, and a shift-drag resize at one and at four motions a frame, each inside its own perf window so sara_perf.py tables what an event and a frame cost.

The seven sizes painted on Windows, each at a pen's own 240 reports a second under Sara's pointer at Both, the way a Windows session paints them. The whole matrix of rates and pointers is scenarios/a-small-brush-keeps-up-with-the-pen-measured.json. Each window's state is d15-<preset>-<size>-pen-both, and every stroke leaves a 'Sara stroke:' line in run.log.
